text:
laura (People Ops): Hey folks 1: we've rolled out a refresh to our PTO & short-leave policy. Main changes: a firm 25-day annual carryover cap, "Wellness Days" (1 per quarter), and a short hand-off requirement for absences longer than 5 business days. See the doc link below.

marco (infra): quick Q  is the carryover cap prorated for part-timers or contractors?

laura (People Ops): good call. Contractors are not covered by the carryover cap; part-time employees have a prorated cap based on FTE fraction. HR will send individual statements next week.

anya (senior-swe): hand-off requirement  what counts as an acceptable doc? Can we just link a sprint ticket?

laura (People Ops): linking a sprint ticket is fine if it contains the necessary context. Our recommended minimum: list of ongoing tasks, key contacts, rollback/runbook notes for services you own, and access notes. We made a quick template: "Standard Hand-off Template" in the company drive.

hr-bot: :paperclip: Policy page updated: https://company.internal/policies/pto-refresh (edited by laura)

laura (People Ops): Some implementation details:
- Carryover applies to PTO accrued starting Jan 1, 2026; leftover 2025 balances remain unaffected.
- One-time adjustment: any balances above 25 (as of Jan 1, 2026 accrual) will be converted to a one-time bonus day payout or moved to unpaid leave (options will be emailed).
- Wellness Days do not roll over and do not count toward carryover.

marco (infra): if i take a Wellness Day, does that show up on the team calendar automatically?

laura (People Ops): yes  pick "Wellness Day" in the PTO flow and it will add to your calendar entry and your manager's view. No approval needed unless your team uses local blackout windows.

anya (senior-swe): Does this affect bereavement, jury duty, or other statutory leaves?

laura (People Ops): no changes to statutory leaves or company bereavement policy. This update only touches general PTO and short-leave handoffs.

laura (People Ops): A few practicals for managers:
- Managers must confirm hand-off docs for any team member taking >5 consecutive business days off.
- Submit hand-off confirmation in the People Ops manager checklist (link in policy).
- If you need coverage planning help, request a "Coverage Assist" consult with People Ops and we can help identify temporary backups.

marco (infra): what about holiday blackout periods? We have a release mid-Jan.

laura (People Ops): no company-wide blackout changes. Teams can set local blackouts; managers should coordinate and People Ops will support exceptions for critical infra work.

tess (People Ops): We'll host two short drop-in sessions next week (15 min) to walk through the policy and the hand-off template: Wed 9:30am PST and Thu 4pm PST. Calendar invites incoming.

anya (senior-swe): Appreciate the clarity. One small ask  can Wellness Days be scheduled retroactively if something urgent comes up?

laura (People Ops): We encourage scheduling them in advance but understand life happens. Retroactive Wellness Day requests will be reviewed case-by-case and approved when reasonable.

laura (People Ops): Links: full policy + FAQ: https://company.internal/policies/pto-refresh  |  hand-off template: https://company.internal/hand-offs/standard-template  |  manager checklist: https://company.internal/people-ops/manager-checklist

laura (People Ops): Thanks all  please ping people-ops@redwood.com for edge cases or if you don't see your individual statement email next week.
